prompt: How can you ensure that all access to normal sites (on port 80) on your local network goes through a proxy server? (Choose two.)
choices: Use iptables on the router to block all outgoing port-80 traffic except from the proxy server
Use iptables on the router to redirect all proxy-server traffic directly to the Internet
Use iptables on the router to redirect all outgoing port-80 traffic to the proxy server, except the proxy server itself
Use iptables on the proxy server to redirect all port-80 traffic to the default proxy port
explanation: Block direct outbound port 80 except from the proxy, and redirect clients’ port-80 traffic to the proxy.
